title: PackNeed
description: A durable record that a mission reached a step no approved capability covers. Creating one PAUSES the mission: it calls no model, builds no Pack, grants nothing and delivers nothing. It is the honest alternative to improvising an agent inside a customer run, which is the point at which every review in this system has already happened. A PackNeed carries the exact missing input and output contracts, the requested inspectors and capabilities, and the resolver's own evidence - so a Pack administrator can decide from what actually happened rather than from a description of it.

mission_id.description: The mission that discovered the gap, when there was one. Recorded for audit; it grants nothing and it does not scope access.

requested_by.description: The verified identity whose mission hit the gap. A name for the audit row, never an authorization.

required_accepts.description: Contract NAMES the missing capability would have to consume. Identifier-shaped so this field cannot carry prose, and therefore cannot carry a prompt into an administrator's inbox.

required_produces.description: At least one. A need that cannot say what the missing Pack would PRODUCE is not a need, it is a wish.

requested_inspectors.description: Requirement names the step would need checked. Naming one is not obtaining one.

requested_capabilities.description: Authority the step appeared to need. Questions, not grants: nothing here expands a capability lease, and the runtime stays network=none / credentials=none regardless.

resolver_evidence.description: What the resolver actually considered and why each candidate did not qualify. Reason CODES and pack hashes only - never a mission's requirement text, which is the customer's words and has no business in a platform inbox.

state.description: Named for who the need is waiting on. There is no BUILT and no PROMOTED state: BUILD_REQUESTED means an administrator created a PackBuildRequest, which is itself only a question. Nothing here can become a Pack by a state transition.

decided_by.description: Null until a named administrator decides. Its absence is what makes an automatic resolution impossible to represent.
